confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Siargao's surf-town tourist pricing, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; accommodation (especially 3-star and private room) is less certain and reflects July as a shoulder, rainy-season month. FX: the 0.6955 value and 2026-10-15 date came from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates overview page, which I did not open directly; verify against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Philippine island resort and surf towns (similar to El Nido, Puerto Princesa and Bohol-style tourist towns), priced above Manila-style local levels and below Boracay's premium tier. Drinks are anchored to local beer pricing, with cocktail and wine set as multiples of the beer price.
